description: This file defines a FastAPI application with two GET endpoints, '/items/' and '/users/', each depending on common parameters provided via dependency injection. It demonstrates the use of dependency functions, Annotated types, and route definitions within FastAPI.

methods.name: common_parameters(q: str | None = None, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100)
methods.description: An asynchronous dependency function that retrieves common query parameters 'q', 'skip', and 'limit' from the request and returns them as a dictionary.

methods.name: read_items(commons: CommonsDep)
methods.description: An asynchronous route handler for GET '/items/' that receives common parameters via dependency injection and returns them.

methods.name: read_users(commons: CommonsDep)
methods.description: An asynchronous route handler for GET '/users/' that receives common parameters via dependency injection and returns them.

ctags.name: common_parameters
ctags.pattern: /^async def common_parameters(q: str | None = None, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100):$/
ctags.signature: (q: str | None = None, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100)
